mapper.select: SELECT id, code, name, pitch_type AS pitchType, description, display_order AS displayOrder, is_active AS isActive, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM wiki_pitch WHERE is_active = true ORDER BY display_order, id

SELECT wpg.id, wpg.pitch_code AS pitchCode, wpg.grade, wpg.velocity_min AS velocityMin, wpg.velocity_max AS velocityMax, wpg.break_amount AS breakAmount, wpg.description, wpg.created_at AS createdAt, wpg.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM wiki_pitch_grade wpg INNER JOIN wiki_pitch wp ON wp.code = wpg.pitch_code AND wp.is_active = true ORDER BY wpg.pitch_code, wpg.grade

SELECT id, target, stat_code AS statCode, influence_type AS influenceType, influence_target AS influenceTarget, weight, description, display_order AS displayOrder, is_active AS isActive, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM wiki_stat_influence WHERE is_active = true AND target = #{target} ORDER BY display_order, id

SELECT id, code, name, pitch_type AS pitchType, description, display_order AS displayOrder, is_active AS isActive, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM wiki_pitch ORDER BY display_order, id

SELECT id, pitch_code AS pitchCode, grade, velocity_min AS velocityMin, velocity_max AS velocityMax, break_amount AS breakAmount, description, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM wiki_pitch_grade ORDER BY pitch_code, grade

SELECT id, pitch_code AS pitchCode, grade, velocity_min AS velocityMin, velocity_max AS velocityMax, break_amount AS breakAmount, description, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM wiki_pitch_grade WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, target, stat_code AS statCode, influence_type AS influenceType, influence_target AS influenceTarget, weight, description, display_order AS displayOrder, is_active AS isActive, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM wiki_stat_influence WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wiki_pitch (code, name, pitch_type, description, display_order, is_active, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{pitchType}, #{description}, #{displayOrder}, true, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE wiki_pitch SET is_active = false, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wiki_pitch_grade (pitch_code, grade, velocity_min, velocity_max, break_amount, description, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{pitchCode}, #{grade}, #{velocityMin}, #{velocityMax}, #{breakAmount}, #{description}, NOW(), NOW())

INSERT INTO wiki_stat_influence (target, stat_code, influence_type, influence_target, weight, description, display_order, is_active, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{target}, #{statCode}, #{influenceType}, #{influenceTarget}, #{weight}, #{description}, #{displayOrder}, true, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE wiki_stat_influence SET is_active = false, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
